title: Identity: meshIRCd did:key and mimid did:webvh, a shared story
description: Mark 2026-11-21: bead only for now. meshIRCd logs in with SASL including did:key; mimid uses did:webvh credentials (draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential). Explore mapping a did:key to a did:webvh (did:webvh can embed or rotate from a key), using the same DID across the IRC bridge and MIMI, and what a client would show. Revisit with the IRC bridge.
